numericFindings: Both locales: read all 180 target fields directly against all six Japanese lessons, including titles, objectives, activities, headings and bodies; scope is 12 lesson-locale pairs.

Both locales: fertilizer duration is inclusive ≥1 year (Bengali এক বছর বা তার বেশি; Nepali एक वर्ष वा त्यसभन्दा बढी), explicitly some types only, not a product guarantee. Patches retain this inequality.

Both locales: 56.2万t × 10000 = 562000 tonnes and 13.5万t × 10000 = 135000 tonnes. Target 562,000 টন/टन and 135,000 টন/टन are exact conversions; approximately, 2018, Japan-national and facility-only scope are retained in bodies and example records.

Both locales: activity and facility paragraph6 retain the per-10a denominator, falling planted area versus rising yield per10a, and no supplied comparison years or percentage change. Bengali area terminology patches clarify area without altering numbers.

Both locales: 硝安 and 硝酸アンモニウム remain aliases for one ammonium-nitrate fertilizer; mixture prevalence remains many, not all; pellet shape remains separate from ingredient mixture, and microbial decomposition remains distinct from chemical low solubility.

Both locales: all five hormone classes and trace-amount biosynthesis/growth/differentiation are retained. ABA teaches seed dormancy only; ethylene retains both flowering directions; no abscission, dose or universal-response assertion added.

Both locales: herbicide selectivity versus uptake/application routes, reduced soil-treatment efficacy on larger weeds, equipment residue versus drift are distinguished without current product permission claims. Vegetable shape/season/place/transplanting and spinach year-round cultivation remain separate.

Both locales: fruit examples retain Unshu mikan, generic pear ナシ without narrowing to Japanese pear, source purposes rather than recipes, and self-propelled versus riding-type distinction. Propagation wording patches preserve the intended organ-formation contrast.
